verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is agentic-payments infrastructure: agent-specific tokens, passkey-authenticated purchase mandates, credential retrieval and the Trusted Agent Protocol. A payments platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from a user's data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents any in-product feature that analyzes user data to produce insights or suggestions. The MCP server and agent toolkit only let external agents perform operations such as invoices and payment links, which is not the same capability.
